ngaap.items_eps_impact_wording: "Impact on Diluted Earnings Per Share from Continuing Operations" (0.01) for the year (net income from continuing operations attributable to common shareowners (10)). Q4: "Results for the quarter included $0.25 per share of restructuring and one-time charges ... Before these items, earnings per share decreased $0.12 or 9 percent year over year." No adjusted EPS figure is stated. 10-K: discontinued-operations EPS includes $0.82 of goodwill and net asset impairments and a $1.01 gain on the Hamilton Sundstrand Industrial disposition.
ngaap.guidance: With broad based improvement in our order trends, and a continued focus on integration and execution, we remain confident in our ability to deliver 2013 earnings per share of $5.85 to $6.15. We continue to expect sales between $64 and $65 billion and cash flow from operations less capital expenditures to equal or exceed net income attributable to common shareowners in 2013. (Headline: "UTC REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL YEAR EPS OF $1.04 AND $5.35; REAFFIRMS 2013 EPS OUTLOOK OF $5.85 TO $6.15". All financial results and projections reflect continuing operations unless otherwise noted.)
ngaap.definitions: Segment net sales, operating profits and margins "as adjusted for the aforementioned restructuring costs and non-recurring items. Management believes these adjusted results more accurately portray the ongoing operational performance and fundamentals of the underlying businesses." Free cash flow from continuing operations = net cash flows provided by operating activities of continuing operations less capital expenditures ("the principal cash performance measure used by UTC"). Organic sales growth excludes foreign currency translation, acquisitions and divestitures completed in the preceding twelve months and significant non-recurring items.
